description: Site integration in a React (Vite) project: the agent copies the official Basic SVGs into public/, writes one React label component with ARIA, a translatable text label, an Icon Colour for light or dark backgrounds and a keyboard-accessible second layer, and uses it below the AI-generated hero image. No image is burned in.

src/App.css.text:
.post { max-width: 40rem; margin: 0 auto; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }
.hero { width: 100%; height: auto; }

prompt: /eu-ai-labelling add AI labels to my React site. I want a reusable label component, and use it in src/App.jsx right below the hero image, which was generated with AI. Add a short explanation that opens on hover or click.
